title: O'Connell 2012 AF biaxial, circumferential direction held, axial stress vs axial strain - digitised from Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7a
condition: mixed degeneration (T1rho 46-146 ms); severely degenerate excluded

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: axial nominal stress (force / reference cross-sectional area) vs axial strain with the circumferential direction held fixed, as plotted by Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7a; primary reports 2D Lagrangian strain E (assumed plotted as E; nominal_strain = sqrt(1+2E) - 1 added)

source.authors: O'Connell GD, Sen S, Elliott DM
source.sample: 16 anterior AF circumferential-axial square samples (7.1 x 7.0 x 2.1 mm) from 13 lumbar spine sections (25-80 y); whether the plotted curve is one sample or a mean is not stated in Ghezelbash 2021

protocol.summary: Square circ-axial AF samples gripped on four edges; 10 min 0.5 N preload; 10 preconditioning cycles to 2 %; five strain ratios incl. circumferential-fixed; stretched at quasi-static 0.01 %/s along the primary direction, max 1.5 MPa; strain from 4 tracked beads (Lagrangian E); stress = force / reference area (protocol from the primary abstract/full text on PMC3500512).
how_to_simulate: Square sample w=10 mm, grip width wg=7.26 mm, grip length lg=0.79 mm, thickness 2.1 mm (Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7b)
Hold the circumferential grips fixed, pull axially, quasi-static
Nominal stress = force/(wg x thickness); strain from a central 3x3 mm square
protocol.notes: SECONDARY digitisation (primary PDF not in donwload/). Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7a shows the measured curve as symbols ('O'Connell et al. [61]').
